links.comparator_used: OpenAI's ChatGPT 3.5 (no retrieval from the CPIC knowledge base). The RAG assistant also used GPT-4, prompt engineering and guardrails, so the comparison is confounded.
links.outcome: Performance on a specialized PGx question catalog, especially provider-specific queries needing specialized data and citations
links.effect: Reported qualitatively as better performance than ChatGPT 3.5; no numeric effect given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Accuracy, relevancy and representative language still need improvement; ethical, regulatory and safety concerns remain.
links.quote: Compared with OpenAI’s ChatGPT 3.5, it demonstrated better performance, especially in provider-specific queries requiring specialized data and citations.
